## What changed

Describe the contribution and why it belongs in Open Flow.

## Contribution type

- [ ] New product
- [ ] New screens
- [ ] New flow
- [ ] Updated screens or metadata
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Code or tooling
- [ ] Policy or moderation

## Privacy and authorization

- [ ] I inspected every submitted image at full size.
- [ ] Every recognizable real person and face is blurred or removed.
- [ ] Every personal profile picture is blurred or removed.
- [ ] Names, usernames, handles, contact details, locations, and other identifying information are removed.
- [ ] Private messages, financial data, medical data, credentials, secrets, QR codes, and private links are absent.
- [ ] I sanitized the files before uploading them anywhere to GitHub.
- [ ] I captured the interface through lawful and authorized access.
- [ ] I did not bypass access controls or submit leaked or confidential material.

## Quality and metadata

- [ ] Images use their original aspect ratio and have no decorative device frame.
- [ ] Files follow the naming and folder rules.
- [ ] Metadata matches the schemas.
- [ ] Capture dates, platforms, regions, and versions are accurate when known.
- [ ] I checked for duplicates.

## Notes for reviewers

Add anything reviewers should know. Do not paste private information here.
